execution_message.text: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: two-key-pose game action strip. Image 1 is the ONLY approved character master for identity/style. EXACTLY TWO equal-width horizontal slots LEFT TO RIGHT; one isolated full-body character in each, SAME drawing size/camera/head-body proportions and common source ground plane, generous transparent margins. Genuine alpha, no labels/panel dividers/floor/cast shadow/matte/motion blur. Do not overlap slot borders or clip any extremity. Preserve Soft Handmade 2.5D, warm dark-brown outline, controlled fine pencil/paper grain, soft SCREEN UPPER LEFT light. Do not draw any snack, tray, question mark, glitter, extra prop or duplicate character within a slot. Approved mint Dinosaur dinosaur-01: preserve large friendly tilted head, short rounded body, cream belly with EXACTLY TWO separate curved brown lines, soft yellow rounded dorsal spikes, peach cheeks, long curled tail, short stubby feet and toe marks. Dark round eyes without iris/sclera, each has LARGE primary at SCREEN upper-left (35% across, 28% down eye bounds), SMALL secondary lower-right. Magnifying glass stays in ANATOMICAL LEFT hand (viewer RIGHT), same orange/yellow frame and pale blue lens. Anatomical right hand stays free near chest; no snack/tray baked in. Same reference frontal three-quarter camera in both frames; friendly non-distressing movement. Pose 0 LEFT SLOT: gentle stumble/contact pose: torso leans slightly forward, one short foot extends forward to catch balance, other foot remains in support, free right hand slightly reaches for balance. Keep face and eyes recognizable, small uncertain w-shaped smile, no crying/damage/star effects. Pose 1 RIGHT SLOT: recovery pose, both short feet return to grounded stable stance, torso upright and friendly w-smile restored. Both complete full-body poses within margins, no flat lying pose or lost magnifier. Do not add extra belly lines, lengthen legs or radically tilt/enlarge head.
